$comment: The source of sf-sortable's interface (core/js/element-manifest.js over core/js/composition/manifest-host.mjs). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/sortable (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

group.summary: The list's group: an item moves between lists of one group; required for a list whose items move

accepts.summary: Other groups whose items this list takes, separated by spaces

mode.summary: copy: a library list; its items are copied out and stay

label.summary: The list's name in what is announced

preview.summary: silhouette opens a gap the size of the item; line draws a line

inserter-items.summary: What an insertion point offers, as JSON or the inserterItems property: [{value, label?, icon?, caption?, keywords?, disabled?}], with {type: "heading", label} and {type: "separator"} rows; sf-sortable-insert carries the chosen value as detail.item. Empty: no insertion point.

move.summary: The request to move (or copy) an item to a place: one manual move of vocabulary 1.1.5 §5 move, {id, parent, position} named item, to and index; the host applies it

state.summary: A drag's step: picked up, dropped or cancelled

insert.summary: The inserter's request to put a new item of the palette at a place; cancelable

check.summary: The host's word on a target list before an item goes there (the handle's «Move to», a drag, the keys); cancelable: preventDefault() refuses, detail.reason says why on the disabled row of the menu

default.$comment: The list draws nothing of its own besides its live region and instructions: the host's items are its markup. The behaviour is the composition module (core/js/composition/sortable.mjs, the inserter sortable-inserter.mjs).

accessibility.$comment: No role of its own: the host's list keeps its role. The list is one Tab stop (BV-6): the item a person was on last (else the selected one, else the first) takes Tab, every other item and every control inside an item is -1; the list's axis (up/down, or start/end in a horizontal list) and Home/End go between items, the other axis toward its end goes into the item's controls and back, Escape on a control returns to its item; an sf-list-item row keeps its own roving. Enter picks an item up; Space selects a selectable item (a selection mark inside it, or aria-selected the host keeps; C146 (8)) and picks up only an item that is not selectable (BV-8, dispatcher's decision 2026-11-17); on the handle, Enter and Space are the button's own: they open the move menu. While an item is held the arrows move it, Home and End to the ends, Enter or Space drop it, Escape or Tab put it back. Each step is said in a polite live region. An item without a role of its own takes one (button; group when it holds the handle or another control) and every item says it can be moved (aria-roledescription, the page language's word). A press on a handle that is not a drag, or the menu key on an item (Shift+F10, ContextMenu), opens the move menu (sf-menu-context: up, down, to the top, to the bottom, and «Move to» with the lists of the group, a list the host refused disabled with its reason, BV-7); the handle's control says aria-haspopup=menu.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-sortable for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.note: the alias table planned sf-sortable; the vocabulary's sf-sortable-move decides
rows.summary: The person dropped an item; the host applies or refuses the change.

rows.note: the manifest declares the verb; the DOM name sf-sortable-state is unchanged, so the shim has nothing to send
rows.summary: A drag session started (picked) or ended (dropped, cancelled).

rows.note: the manifest declares the verb; the DOM name sf-sortable-insert is unchanged, so the shim has nothing to send
rows.summary: The person chose a kind in the inserter for a place in the list; the host creates the item at index. Bubbles, is composed and is cancelable: preventDefault() refuses and keeps the inserter open.

x-summary: A list whose items move by pointer, touch and keyboard, between lists of a group and onto registered drop targets; it asks the host to move and never moves the host's DOM or data.
x-renamed: events.sf-sortable-intent → move: the vocabulary's move (§5.1 alias table row sf-sortable-intent → sf-sortable-move); sf-sortable-move, the old name a dated same-detail alias
events sf-sortable-state and sf-sortable-insert keep their DOM names (state and insert, own verbs)
lang runtime holds the words of the drag module and the inserter (MESSAGES of core/js/composition/sortable.mjs and sortable-inserter.mjs)
x-decisions: alias-conflict: the alias table's planned sf-sortable-intent → sf-sortable and this conversion's sf-sortable-move -- the vocabulary decides (1.1.5 §5.1, sf-sortable-intent → sf-sortable-move): sf-sortable-move, with the old sf-sortable-intent following as a same-detail alias until 2026-12-01. An sf-sortable list sends it through its aliases.json; a container the column mode attached to (SF.Sortable.attach), which has no shim, sends both names. sf-tabs, which arranges its tabs with a list, listens to the new name. The legacy manifest's event key sf-sortable was never a DOM name: no alias.

move's detail stays {item, from, to, index, mode}: one manual move, the form vocabulary §5 move keeps ({id, parent, position}); a same-detail alias needs the old fields, and the host gets no new field to learn.

own-verb-words: state (picked, dropped, cancelled -- one fact of a drag's steps, its DOM name kept) and insert (the inserter's cancelable request to put a palette item at a place: not §5 create, the host may create nothing, only place) are this component's verbs; their words are events.<name>.label of the language files.

element: sf-sortable stays the plain element the composition module defines (the overlay's bundle defines the same list without an inserter); defineSortable takes the class core/js/composition/manifest-host.mjs makes from this component.json -- the settings' properties, sfEmit and sfWord, the aliases.json shim installed when the list is placed. group and mode keep the module's readings (a group that is no name is no group; any mode but copy is move).
a11y-role: none -- the host's list keeps its own role; the list is one Tab stop and its items are reached with the arrows (BV-6), described by the list's instructions.

key-effects: on an item Enter picks up and Space selects a selectable item or picks up any other (select), Enter or Space drops; outside a move the arrows and Home/End go between items (focus:prev/next/first/last), inside one they stand for the place the item moves to; Escape puts it back (revert), Tab leaves the list (reach).

item-shape: the list holds the host's elements, not a list setting; item_contract (description, properties) describes inserter-items, a JSON setting of {item, label, icon?, description?} the inserter reads -- a string attribute, so no of.

words (§11): the language files hold the drag module's and the inserter's words; the composition modules keep their own copy because the overlay's bundle and the column mode draw with them without this component, and read them through the page's language as before.
version 1.1.0: an event renamed behind a dated alias (§4.10).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (a list of blocks) plus a horizontal list, a copy library and a list with an inserter.

css-variables: five public variables of its sheet, all of a drag in progress: the dragged item's and the ghost's opacity, the ghost's layer, the drop line's colour and the silhouette's border. They are not in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json: its browser probe measures a component at rest, where none of these parts exist.
source-drift: the shipped manifest differs from 5100227 in the inserter (inserter-items, sf-sortable-insert) and its provenance; the conversion here carries them by hand.

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.

version 1.1.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.1.6: the inserter asks for the standard menu through SF.Loader.ensure (core.runtime 1.19.0), not a race of whenDefined against 3 s of its own (reuse audit 2026-11-02, finding 4); without the menu it still falls back as before.

version 1.1.8: the id of the instructions its items name in aria-describedby is sf-sortable-help-<n>, a page-wide count (core.runtime 1.38.0), not 8 random base-36 characters; about one random id in 32 held h1..h6 and made the Loader ask for the headers utility on some loads only. Behaviour otherwise unchanged.

version 1.2.1: the size rule C18 (2026-11-09): the drop indicator's corner is --sf-radius-1/3 (2 px, as before) and the outlines read --sf-radius--ui with no raw fallback (4 px, as before). The ghost's shadow is left to the elevation helper (C20). Also: the dragged copy is the overlay place and the insert button the raised one (C20, the shadow system, owner 2026-11-08): --sf-shadow-overlay with no value of its own (it fell back to a raw black at 30 per cent), --sf-shadow-raised on --sf-surface-raised. Nothing else changes.

version 1.2.2 (2026-11-10, docs pre-check, C15; core sortable-inserter): a patch. The insert button between items is a tonal on-surface icon button; it wrote the surface look (a faint fill with a boundary), which the icon button no longer has (component.icon-buttons 1.6.0; the former class draws as tonal). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.2.3 (2026-11-11): a patch, nothing drawn differently. The sheet reads the C16 roles by their current names where it read the former ones, which are var() of them wherever they are declared (src/core/contracts/token-aliases.v1.json, sf-role-aliases): --sf-outline-primary → --sf-primary-outline ×2; --sf-primary-transparent-select → --sf-primary-state-select ×2. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.1 (2026-11-14, owner decisions C173 point 7 and C181 (3), the layer roles): a patch. The dragged copy, the drop line and the column outline read the popover layer (--sf-layer--popover, 90, as before). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-14, owner decision C171 and study defects SO-1..SO-6, control/research/2026-11-14-sortable.md; written on the branch as 1.3.0): a minor. (1) A press on a handle that does not become a drag opens the standard menu «Выше · Ниже · В начало · В конец» (sf-menu-context, a lazy relation already); a choice sends the same move request a drag ends with and says the same «dropped» words; ends of the list are disabled, not removed; focus comes back to the moved row's handle. (2) A row without a handle no longer sets touch-action: none: a finger takes it after a 0.5 s long press (a move of more than 8 px before that scrolls the page); the mouse still takes it after 4 px. (3) The copy under the pointer is whole: the dimming of the source is no longer copied into it, --sf-sortable-ghost-opacity defaults to 1 (was .9), and it stands on the popup surface with the overlay shadow (C20), so a row without a fill reads. (4) One drop line, 2 px (SORTABLE_DROP_LINE of the drag module), drawn by .sf-sortable-indicator, which the editor overlay draws with too. Also SO-1: items without a role take button (group when they hold a handle or control) and aria-roledescription «перемещаемый» / draggable; SO-5: under a finger the inserter's «+» is the phone step 36 (rung 1) with a 44 target. New words in lang/ (runtime: roledescription, move-menu, move-up, move-down, move-first, move-last). Settings and events unchanged.

version 1.4.1 (2026-11-16, defect TL-8 of the toolbar and row-menu study, ui-control control/research/2026-11-14-toolbar-menu-open.md; above 1.4.0 of every branch): a patch, nothing drawn or heard differently. The inserter's menu and the handle's move menu are placed by core's one standard-menu helper (core/js/overflow-row.js standardMenu, which asks the Loader for sf-menu-context and answers null without it) instead of two copies of their own; their listeners, search Enter, focus and the menus' rows unchanged.

version 1.5.1 (2026-11-17, feat/lang-file-c282; numbered above 1.5.0 on origin/fix/layer-order-c273): a patch. Russian is a language file (owner decision C282, 2026-11-17): the bundle carries the English words only (lang/index.mjs, written by scripts/build-language-packs.mjs from src/core/lang/built-in.json); the Russian ones come from core/lang/ru.js included before core, or from the ru part of its family that core fetches, and SF.Loader holds the definition until that part is here (at most 800 ms). A page with the language file draws the same Russian as before; lang/ru.json is unchanged.

version 1.5.2 (written on the branch as 1.5.0; 2026-11-17): a minor (owner decision C273, utility or component). The component's fill, edge colour, text colour and the place roles it declares stand in the new cascade layer sf.paint, under the utilities, so a bg-*, border-* or color-* class on it or on one of its parts now paints it; its size, padding, radius, height and edge width stay in sf.components, over the utilities. The look without a utility is unchanged (the built sheets hold the same declarations, the paint ones in sf.paint). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.6.0 (2026-11-17, feat/orders-sortable-menu-toast, view round 1 order D1): a minor. SF.Sortable.attach has a row mode, orientation: 'vertical', for rows a list or a table body cannot wrap in sf-sortable: the same intent ({item, from, index, group} to onIntent, index among the group's items without the moving one), the one 2 px drop line across the extent (preview 'line', C171 (4); 'column' draws an outline of the row's height), a whole copy of the row under the pointer (a table row is copied with its column widths), the window or the nearest scroll container scrolling at its top and bottom edges. A handle (option handle) is where a drag begins and a press on it that does not become a drag opens the move menu «Выше · Ниже · В начало · В конец» through SF.menu.open (C171 (1)); a row without a handle is taken by a mouse after 4 px and by a finger after a long press (C171 (2)). Keys (keyboard, default true): Space or Enter on a focused row picks it up, arrows move it, Space or Enter drops, Escape or Tab cancels, each step said in the live region and the keys named through aria-describedby, as on a list; focus comes back to the moved row. A row is named in the announcements and the menu by its cells joined by commas, without the handle's name (labelOf overrides). The row mode sends sf-sortable-state {state, item} from the container; detach.move(item, index) asks a move without dragging. The column mode is unchanged.

version 1.7.0 (2026-11-17, fix/sortable-bv; board study defects BV-6..BV-9, ui-control control/research/2026-11-17-board-view, DEV msg-c226d8962ade4bfd839d; above 1.6.0 of every branch): a minor. (BV-6) A list is one Tab stop: the item a person was on last takes Tab (else the selected one, else the first), every other item and every control inside an item leaves the Tab order (its own tabindex kept in data-sf-sortable-tabindex and given back when the list goes); outside a move the list's axis and Home/End go between items and the other axis goes into an item's controls and back (the APG layout grid, as a table's rows, C146 (8)), Escape on a control returns to its item; logical in a right-to-left page, for vertical and horizontal lists; an sf-list-item row keeps its own roving. A board of 15 cards was 72 Tab stops. (BV-7) The handle's menu has «Move to» (Переместить в) with the lists of the group in the page's order: the list the item is in checked and disabled, a list the host refused disabled with its reason as the row's caption. The host refuses through the new cancelable sf-sortable-check {item, from, to, reason} on the target list (preventDefault(), detail.reason; no reason: «Сюда нельзя» / Not here); the same refusal holds for a drag and a keyboard move. A choice sends the request a drag between lists ends with (sf-sortable-move, to the end of the target) with its «dropped» words, and focus comes back to the item's handle in its new list. The menu key on an item (Shift+F10, ContextMenu) opens the same menu, so «Move to» needs no pointer and no drag (WCAG 2.5.7). (BV-8, dispatcher's decision 2026-11-17) Enter picks an item up; Space selects a selectable item -- a selection mark inside it (a checkbox) is pressed, an item with aria-selected is left to its host -- and picks up only an item that is not selectable, so Space marks a record in a board as in a table (C146 (8)); Enter and Space on the handle are the button's own (the move menu); Escape cancels; the row mode of SF.Sortable.attach follows the same rule. The instructions say «Пробел — выбрать, Enter — взять…» on a list of selectable items. (BV-9) The live region and the instructions stand at the start corner of their containing block (inset 0, visually hidden, no off-screen offset): without an offset they stood where they would have flowed, and in a board scrolling sideways with no position of its own that place was past the page's end (+1155 px at 390). New words in lang/ (runtime: move-to, refused, instructions-select; instructions now names Enter first).

version 1.7.1 (2026-11-18, fix/sortable-label-of-pages; above 1.7.0 of every branch): a patch, nothing drawn differently. The name an item has in the handle menu's label and the live announcements no longer glues its parts: a board card said «Заказ № 1002 Кафе «Лето»5 070,00 ₽» (board study note 2). In order: the item's aria-label; the text of what aria-labelledby names; the part marked data-sf-sortable-label or slot="title"; else its visible text with a comma between its blocks (a block, an inline-block, a flex or grid item; display: contents passes through; inline text stays in its line): «Заказ № 1002, Кафе «Лето», 5 070,00 ₽». Decorative parts (aria-hidden, hidden, tooltips, the live region, the row mode's handle) are not read. The row mode of SF.Sortable.attach reads each cell the same way and still joins cells with commas. core/js/composition/sortable.mjs exports sortableItemLabel and sortableReadableText; the move menu reads the same name.

version 1.7.2 (2026-11-18, fix/board-fw; view round 2 board order; above 1.7.1 of every branch): a patch. A list that stands inside another element's printed first paint (a board drew its cards into it, and the snapshot printed the board) is part of that picture: it no longer clears its children as static markup when its code comes before the board's, so the cards stay on screen until the board draws its live lanes; it adds no live region and takes no keys until then (core/js/composition/manifest-host.mjs sfInPicture, the rule smart-base keeps for Smart elements). A list the page wrote ends its first paint as before; cards marked slot="item" are unchanged.

version 1.7.3 (2026-11-18): a patch (numbered above 1.7.2 on origin/fix/board-fw): one focus offset (DEV held answers H3, owner decision C212, msg-bc1702eb): the ring stands at --sf-focus--offset (outside) or --sf-focus--inset (inside a filled cell) instead of its own number; only the forced-colours rules keep 2px.

$comment: The insertion point (inserter-items) is a native icon button of the
Framework's own look with an icon glyph, and the inserter it opens is the
fetched after the page is ready, and at once by a list that turns its inserter
on, so a list without one costs nothing more than before.

item_contract.description: Descendants with data-sf-sortable-item="<id>" are items; an optional data-sf-sortable-handle inside an item limits dragging to the handle and is the touch target.

drop_targets.description: SF.Sortable.registerSortableDropTarget({resolve, keyboardTargets, drop, leave}) joins non-list targets such as sf-composition-overlay to the same drag session; the session is shared across Smart bundles. Once loaded, SF.Sortable exposes SORTABLE_INTENT_EVENT, SORTABLE_STATE_EVENT, activeSortableSession, registerSortableDropTarget and sortableIndexAt.

inserter.description: The insertion point is one native icon button (size 1/3), the list's last tab stop, placed on the gap a pointer is near, after a focused row, or where its arrow keys put it. It opens sf-context-menu (openFor, local search over label, caption and keywords) anchored to the point. The component never creates the inserted item: it raises sf-sortable-insert and the host adds the item. Escape closes only the inserter, the innermost open surface (core open-surface-mark). Once loaded, SF.Sortable exposes SORTABLE_INSERT_EVENT.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-sortable when people reorder or move host items, or drag library entries onto an editor canvas. Apply sf-sortable-intent to the host model with an expected revision; a refusal leaves the page unchanged. Give inserter-items when people insert new items at a place in the list; create the item on sf-sortable-insert.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not let the component move host DOM or save data
Do not rely on pointer dragging alone; keep the keyboard path
Do not bundle a private drag session; use SF.Sortable.registerSortableDropTarget
Do not let the component create the inserted item; add it on sf-sortable-insert

accessibility.focus: Items become focusable and describe the instructions. Space or Enter picks up, arrows move within a list and to other accepting lists or external targets, Space or Enter drops, Escape or Tab cancels. Every step is announced in a polite live region in the page language. With inserter items, + on a focused row opens the inserter for the place after it, and the insertion point is the list's last tab stop: arrows move it between places, Home and End go to the first and the last, Enter or Space opens the inserter; in the inserter typing filters, arrows and Enter choose, Escape closes it and returns focus.

sf-sortable-intent.summary: The person dropped an item; the host applies or refuses the change.
